scope: Authorized host filesystem commands: streaming import/export, conditional FileProvider save, timezone, cancellation, explicit pause and accepted-work drain.

architecture.execution: Existing bounded disk pool; host poller submits accepted original-resource work without a cohort join.
architecture.mapping: Existing FileLayouts backing admission for exports and conditional saves; affected mapped-byte dependants still quiesce.
architecture.storage: Anonymous unpublished bounded streaming staging; atomic namespace publication and original quota accounting.
architecture.edit_commit: Original filesystem -> inode -> plain byte locks cover content validation through the path swap. No ordinary guest synchronization is added.
architecture.cold_cost: A conditional content hash can block original filesystem observers. Holding the original mapped backing ticket across its staging/check/commit also pauses actual mapping dependants. No browser or throughput speedup claim is made.
architecture.ownership: Pending source namespace/credentials are observed without consuming cold publication or retiring original Files/fs ownership; accepted jobs retain original resources.
architecture.pause: Explicit pause remains a deliberate execution boundary; driver keeps disk/backing work live while guest execution is paused.
architecture.fallback: Only a genuinely absent host-I/O binding retains the legacy stopped command route.

coverage: manifest failure and anonymous staging release

remaining: Actual pause/cancel and final host shutdown/deadlines

Known-resource/subcommand and unhandled HLT/fault final dispatch
